newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gap Inc raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gap Inc raised.

text.p: -- Lazard Freres analyst Todd Slater raised his rating on The Gap Inc to buy from neutral, his office said.
-- Further details were not immediately available.
-- "Yesterday, then stock retreated 15 percent which we believe was an over-reaction to the flat comp-store sales report and represents a good buying opportunity," Slater said in a research note.
"We believe The Gap should be able to achieve a secular growth rate of 15 percent with upside from Old Navy and strong growth potential internationally beyond the year 2000."
